answer: Give every agent a falcon's view from a small knoll: reward agents that see the whole field from a modest vantage point, not those that shout loudest from the valley. Start each identity from one kernel of verified work, and let its trust score climb only when independent peers attest to real deliveries. Cheap copies spun up on borrowed compute gain nothing until each earns its own attestations, so flooding the network costs effort per identity instead of scaling for free.
